message.reasoning:
The user asks about "any available class at University in Sydney in May". This seems like they want information about university classes (courses) rather than concerts. There's no tool for checking courses; only one tool exists for concerts. So we cannot use it.

We should respond with an apology or explanation that we can't help with this request because there's no relevant data source. We can ask clarifying question if needed but likely just say not possible.
